Regarding the potential insider threat described in the text, the primary suspect is the former research and development team lead. Several risk factors point to this individual: the recent resignation coincides with the disappearance of several prototypes, there is evidence of unusual behavior (working late the week before departure), and the missing items were last accounted for in his possession. The absence of forced entry further suggests that the individual had authorized access and likely took the items intentionally.
